# MicroenvironmentalCueModulation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The use of biochemical and mechanical signals (e.g., growth factors, matrix stiffness) to steer organoid maturation and functional connectivity. Allows controlled tuning of network excitability and criticality, informing design rules for adaptive neuromorphic hardware.
